title: Monitors
description: Composable health checks with dependencies: every check runs on its own schedule; links explain failures (root causes) and keep follow-up alerts quiet.

templates.intro: A template is a monitor with parameters (IP address, asset id, cadence …). Create many monitors from it with a form or a CSV file; when the template changes, instances show "template updated" and can be re-synced.
templates.none: No templates yet. Import "{{example}}" from the example library.

gateways.intro: A gateway (for example the plant's IoT gateway) reports many heartbeat checks in one call to <c>{{endpoint}}</c>, mapped by the check key. It has one secret; the allowed keys limit what it may report.
gateways.rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret of "{{name}}"? The current secret stops working immediately.
gateways.deleteConfirm: Delete gateway "{{name}}"? Its reports will be rejected.
gateways.copyNowText: It is shown only once. Store it in the gateway's configuration; rotate it if it may have leaked.
gateways.manyInOneCall: Report many checks in one call
gateways.reportFormat: Each report: key (the check key), ts (ISO 8601 or Unix time, optional), value, status (up/degraded/down, optional) and data. HMAC mode: add X-Steward-Gateway with the gateway id and X-Steward-Signature.
gateways.allowedCheckKeysHint: Wildcard *, e.g. m17.* – required: a gateway may only report the keys listed here, and only for monitors its owner may edit

secrets.title: Heartbeat secrets
secrets.copyNowText: Each secret is shown only once and cannot be recovered. Store it in the reporting system (for example the IoT gateway). If one is lost or leaked, rotate it on the check.

form.name: Name
form.checkIdHint: Letters, digits, _ and -; used in links, item keys and the API
form.fallbackPortHint: Used when ICMP is not available (default 80)
form.useProxy: Use the proxy from the environment
form.variablesHint: The newest value of each must be fresh; the worst counts
form.sharedCall: Checks on the same asset and aspect share one Insights Hub call per cycle.
form.timestampHint: Over the response body; a timestamp or a list (the newest counts)
form.statusExpressionHint: Returns up, degraded, down or true/false; default: the report's status field
form.gatusMaxAge: Down when the newest result is older than (s)
form.gatusRecent: Degraded on failures in the last N results
form.subMonitorHint: Evaluated on its own schedule; this node shows its aggregated status
form.critical: Critical (a failure takes the monitor down)
form.gatusSourceHint: Metrics: the state Steward scrapes from Gatus' /metrics (Platform → Metrics). API: Gatus' status API (needs basic auth when Gatus is protected).

gatusSources.auto: Automatic (metrics when enabled for the platform)

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" with its history? Heartbeat URLs stop working.
detail.templateUpdatedText: This monitor was created from an older version of its template. Re-sync replaces the definition with the current template version (parameters stay).
detail.disabled: This monitor is paused – its checks do not run and it sends no messages. Resume it at the top of the page.
detail.graphHint: Arrows point from a check to the checks that depend on it. Dashed: soft link (both run; a failing parent explains the child). Solid: hard link (the child is not evaluated while the parent is down). Click a check for details.
detail.likelyCausedByNoAlert: Likely caused by {{causes}} – no separate alert is sent for this check.
detail.openHiddenMonitor: Includes a monitor you cannot view.
detail.pauseConfirm: A paused monitor runs no checks and sends no messages until it is resumed; its status shows as unknown, also to monitors that depend on it. For planned work use a maintenance window instead: the checks keep running and only the messages pause.

maintenance.title: Maintenance – {{name}}
maintenance.intro: Checks keep running and their results are recorded, but the monitor shows "maintenance", notifications and runbooks are silenced, and the time does not count against uptime.
maintenance.vsPause: To stop the checks altogether, pause the monitor at the top of the page.

outputs.title: Outputs

notification.label: Notification (in-app, e-mail, Teams)
notification.help: The owner and the subscribers are notified about root causes only; dependent failures are folded into one alert.

webhook.label: Webhook (JSON)
webhook.help: POSTs { source, monitor, events[] } with status, status code, root causes and the latest message.

gatus.label: Gatus external endpoint
gatus.help: Pushes success/error to POST /api/v1/endpoints/<key>/external with the platform credential "externalToken".

zabbix.label: Zabbix
zabbix.help: sender: trapper protocol to port 10051 (items of type Zabbix trapper); api: history.push (Zabbix 7.0+, API token). Values: 0 up, 1 degraded, 2 down, 3 unknown, 4 blocked, 5 maintenance.

process.label: Start a process (runbook)
process.help: Starts the runbook as the monitor owner; inputs are JSONata over { monitor, check, event }.

outputs.intro: Outputs send status changes (and optionally every evaluation) to people and other monitoring systems. Placeholders in keys and paths: {{placeholders}}.
outputs.none: No outputs yet – the status is still available in the API, Prometheus metrics and dashboards.
outputs.holdHint: Wait this long so a parent failing a little later still explains the failure (default 0)
outputs.urlHint: Without credentials; for authenticated targets choose a platform instead
outputs.manageOnly: Only the owner, administrators or users with the manage right can change outputs.

heartbeat.rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret? The reporting system must use the new one right away.
heartbeat.setupIntro: Heartbeat checks are fed by another system, for example the IoT gateway: either one call per check with that check's secret, or one call for many checks with a gateway secret (Monitors → Gateways), mapped by the check key. A missing report turns the check down without any request. Body (JSON, max. 64 KB): status (optional: up, degraded, down or true/false), value, ts (ISO 8601 or Unix time) and data.
heartbeat.gatewayKey: Gateway key: <c>{{key}}</c> · secret {{prefix}}… (shown only when created or rotated)

editor.description: Add checks from the palette and connect them: drag from the lower handle of a check to the check that depends on it.
editor.linkHint: Soft: both checks run; when both fail, the dependent check is reported as "likely caused by" the other and no separate alert is sent. Hard: the dependent check is not evaluated (blocked) while this one is down.
editor.selectHint: Select a check to edit it, or click a link to change it.
editor.startHint: Start with a check from the palette.
editor.keyHint: Stable identifier for integrations (Zabbix item keys, LLD, Prometheus, heartbeat keys); default from the name

rules.quorum: Quorum: k of n critical checks up

editor.isTemplate: This is a template (parameters as {{example}}, edited as YAML)
editor.templateYaml: Templates are edited as YAML: {{example}} placeholders may stand anywhere, also where numbers are expected. They are replaced when monitors are created from the template.
editor.linkHowTo: Link cards by dragging from the lower edge of a card to the card that depends on it. A new check is placed below the selected card and depends on it – remove the link when it does not.
editor.previewNote: Tried as it is in the editor, not saved. Nothing is recorded.

acknowledge.title: Acknowledge – {{name}}
acknowledge.intro: Tells others that someone is working on the problem. Further notifications of this monitor are held back until it is up again.

instances.title: New monitors from "{{name}}"
instances.csvHint: One line per monitor. Columns: the parameter names, plus optional "name" and "key". Comma or semicolon separated; the first line is the header.

statusInfo.unknown: No data yet, or the check itself could not run
statusInfo.blocked: Not evaluated because a hard dependency is down
statusInfo.maintenance: In a maintenance window – alerts are silenced

ping.label: Ping
ping.help: ICMP echo via the system ping command; falls back to a TCP connect when ping is not available

tcp.label: TCP port
tcp.help: Opens a TCP connection to host:port

http.label: HTTP(S)
http.help: Calls a URL: expected status, JSONata condition on the body, response time, TLS certificate expiry

platform.label: Platform API
platform.help: Calls an operation through a configured platform (its authentication, base URL and retries)

freshness.label: Data freshness
freshness.help: Latest timestamp of a data source must be recent: expected cadence or maximum age (Insights Hub time series preset)

heartbeat.label: Heartbeat (push)
heartbeat.help: Another system (e.g. an IoT gateway) reports to Steward; missing reports turn the check down

gatus.label: Gatus endpoint
gatus.help: Status of an endpoint monitored by Gatus

monitor.label: Sub-monitor
monitor.help: The aggregated status of another monitor (evaluated on its own schedule)

emptyState.title: No monitors yet
emptyState.text: Monitors you may see will show up here.
emptyState.textCreate: Watch devices, APIs and data flows with composable checks. Create a monitor, or import an example from the library.

platformChoices.title: Platforms
platformChoices.label: Platform for “{{ref}}”
platformChoices.noneOfKind: You may use no platform of kind {{kind}}. Add one, or ask for the “use” right on one.
platformChoices.none: You may use no platform. Add one, or ask for the “use” right on one.

testRun.title: Test run with recorded responses
testRun.help: The platform checks answered by the recorded responses of their platforms. Nothing is stored: no results, no status change, no messages. Other check types need the network and are skipped.
